Developing hydrogen fuel cells
for datacenters
The decreasing cost of renewable sources, advancement
of green hydrogen production technology, and
increasing legislative focus are starting to show
potential to reduce the datacenter industry’s reliance
on fossil-based diesel fuels. Microsoft is demonstrating
the application of green hydrogen at industrial scales—
with a first of its kind, zero emission, 3 MW hydrogen
polymer electrolyte membrane (PEM) fuel cell back-
up power generator piloted in July 2022. PEM fuel
cell technology combines hydrogen and outside air
in a chemical reaction that generates electricity, heat,
